Kueue

Get started · Docs · Community · Help Kueue grow

Kueue is a Kubernetes-native queueing and scheduling system that decides **when**, **where** and **how** your training, inference and batch workloads run. It works alongside kube-scheduler, cluster-autoscaler and your job controllers instead of replacing them. Learn more in the [overview](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/overview/). ## Capabilities at a glance - **[Fair sharing](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/fair_sharing/)** — share quota fairly across teams, with borrowing through [cohorts](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cohort/) and optional preemption. - **[Hierarchical quotas](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cohort/#hierarchical-cohorts)** — organize quota in a tree of cohorts, such as departments and teams. - **[Flavor fungibility](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cluster_queue/#flavorfungibility)** — choose when to try another [resource flavor](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/resource_flavor/), such as spot nodes, before borrowing or preempting. - **[Elastic workloads](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/elastic_workload/)** — scale supported jobs up or down without suspending them, reserving quota for each scale-up. - **[Admission checks](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/admission_check/)** — hold workloads until external checks pass, such as node capacity from cluster-autoscaler. - **[Device quotas (DRA)](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/dynamic_resource_allocation/)** — admit workloads only when there is quota for the GPUs and other devices they request through DRA. - **[All-or-nothing (gang) scheduling](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/all_or_nothing/)** — by default, no Pods start until there is quota for all of them. - **[Topology-Aware Scheduling (TAS)](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/topology_aware_scheduling/)** — place communicating Pods close together, such as on one rack. - **[MultiKueue](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/multikueue/)** — dispatch workloads to other clusters with free capacity.
Integrations: Kubernetes Job, JobSet, KubeRay, LeaderWorkerSet and more **Built-in integrations**, grouped by common use: - **Batch and training:** [Kubernetes Job](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/jobs/) (including [CronJobs](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/run_cronjobs/)), [JobSet](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/jobsets/), [MPIJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/mpijobs/), [RayJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/rayjobs/) ([KubeRay](https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/cluster/kubernetes/index.html)), [TrainJob (Kubeflow Trainer v2)](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/trainjobs/) and [SparkApplication](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/sparkapplications/) (alpha). - **Inference and serving:** [LeaderWorkerSet](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/leaderworkerset/), [RayService](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/rayservices/), [Deployment](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/deployment/) and [StatefulSet](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/statefulset/). - **Other workloads:** [Pods and Pod groups](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/plain_pods/), [AppWrapper](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/appwrappers/) and [RayCluster](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/rayclusters/). **External and custom integrations:** run [external frameworks](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/external_workloads/), such as [Argo Workflows](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/external_workloads/argo_workflow/) and [Tekton](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/external_workloads/tektoncd/), or [write an integration](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/dev/integrate_a_custom_job/) for your own workload types. **Deprecated:** [Kubeflow Trainer v1](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/) jobs ([PyTorchJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/pytorchjobs/), [TFJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/tfjobs/), [JAXJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/jaxjobs/), [PaddleJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/paddlejobs/), [XGBoostJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/kubeflow/xgboostjobs/)); migrate to [TrainJob](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/trainjobs/) or [JobSet](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/jobsets/).
Roadmap: priorities and long-term goals Priorities include integrating with Workload-Aware Scheduling (WAS) in kube-scheduler and continued improvements for training, inference and other workloads. **2026 priorities** - Integrate with Workload-Aware Scheduling (WAS) in kube-scheduler, including Topology-Aware Scheduling [#8871](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8871) - [MultiKueue](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/multikueue/) improvements: - Extend support for elastic Ray workloads, including autoscaling [#13243](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/13243) (replaces [#8712](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8712)) - Add workload-level admission constraints and preference-aware dispatching (proposal [#8729](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8729)) - Prevent starting preemptions in multiple worker clusters [#8303](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8303) - Maintain service availability during cross-cluster moves (proposal [#8526](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8526)) - Retrieve logs from worker clusters [#3526](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/3526) - [Topology-Aware Scheduling](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/topology_aware_scheduling/) improvements: - Support resource transformations [#8860](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8860) - Extend support for [elastic workloads](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/elastic_workload/) [#8160](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8160) - Evict workloads from nodes that become tainted [#8828](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8828) - Support concurrent workload admission [#8691](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8691) - Support large, high-priority jobs ("hero workloads") [#8826](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8826) - Consider preemption cost when finding preemption candidates [#7990](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/7990) - Extend the [Dynamic Resource Allocation (DRA)](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/dynamic_resource_allocation/) integration [#8243](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/8243), [#2941](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/2941) **Long-term goals** - Partial preemption of serving workloads [#3762](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/3762) - Deeper integration with workflow frameworks such as Argo Workflows and Tekton [#74](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/74) - Budget support [#28](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/28) - Flavor assignment strategies, e.g. _minimizing cost_ vs _minimizing borrowing_ [#312](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/312) - Cooperative preemption for workloads that implement checkpointing [#477](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/477) - Delayed preemption for two-stage admission [#3758](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/3758) - Graduate the API to v1 [#3476](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/issues/3476)
## Get started Kubernetes 1.35 or newer is recommended; older versions may work but aren't tested. Install the latest release, or see the [other installation options, including Helm](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/getting-started/installation/): ```shell kubectl apply --server-side -f \ https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/download/v0.20.3/manifests.yaml ``` Then follow the **[quick start](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/getting-started/quick-start/)** to set up resource flavors, queues and quota, and run your first job.
Configuration and operations guides - **Understand queueing:** [workloads](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/workload/), [queueing](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/#queueing) and [admission](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/#admission). - **Configure queues:** [administer cluster quotas](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/administer_cluster_quotas/), then set [priorities](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/workload/#priority) and [queueing strategies](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cluster_queue/#queueing-strategy). - **Share quota:** [cohorts](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cohort/), [borrowing](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cluster_queue/#cohort), [fair-sharing policies](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/preemption/#fair-sharing), [preemption](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cluster_queue/#preemption), [flavor fungibility](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/cluster_queue/#flavorfungibility) and [dynamic reclaim](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/workload/#dynamic-reclaim). - **Size jobs:** start a Job smaller with [partial admission](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/run/jobs/#partial-admission), or resize supported jobs with [elastic workloads](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/elastic_workload/). - **Control admission:** [admission checks](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/admission_check/), [autoscaling with ProvisioningRequest](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/admission_check/provisioning_request/#job-using-a-provisioningrequest), [all-or-nothing scheduling](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/all_or_nothing/), [Pod readiness](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/setup_wait_for_pods_ready/) and [enforcing Kueue management](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/enforce_job_management/). - **Place workloads:** set up [Topology-Aware Scheduling](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/setup_topology_aware_scheduling/) and [MultiKueue](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/setup_multikueue/). - **Manage device quotas:** [DRA concepts](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/dynamic_resource_allocation/) and [DRA setup](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/setup_dra/); consumable capacity is alpha. - **Run in production:** [production setup](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/productization/) (cert-manager, network policies, Prometheus) and [RBAC](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/rbac/). - **Monitor Kueue:** [observability](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/observability/), [metrics](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/reference/metrics/), [pending workloads](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/monitor_pending_workloads/pending_workloads_on_demand/) and the [KueueViz dashboard](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/manage/enable_kueueviz/). Browse [concepts](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/concepts/), [task guides](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/tasks/), [examples](site/static/examples) and [DeepWiki](https://deepwiki.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue).
## Production readiness - Used in production; see the [public adopters](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/community/adopters/). - Minor releases about every two months; see the [release process](RELEASE.md). - Unit, integration and scalability tests, plus end-to-end tests on every [Kubernetes version Kueue officially supports](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/docs/getting-started/installation/#before-you-begin).
Testing and compatibility **API stability:** core APIs use `v1beta2` and follow the [Kubernetes deprecation policy](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/using-api/deprecation-policy/). **Testing:** the dashboards below track the `main` branch, and end-to-end suites run on Kind clusters. **Contribute:** [contributing guide](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [Kubernetes community](https://kubernetes.io/community/) · [code of conduct](code-of-conduct.md) ### Help Kueue grow Showing how people use and value Kueue helps keep the project well supported and growing: - **[Star Kueue](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue)** if you like the project. - **[Add your organization](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/community/adopters/)** if you run Kueue in production, by editing [`site/data/adopters.yaml`](site/data/adopters.yaml). - **[Share your experience](https://kueue.sigs.k8s.io/community/showcase/)** on Medium with the `kueue` tag. --- [Releases](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases) · [Latest release](https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kueue/releases/latest) · Artwork: [Kueue](https://github.com/cncf/artwork/tree/main/projects/kubernetes/sub-projects/kueue), [KueueViz](https://github.com/cncf/artwork/tree/main/projects/kubernetes/sub-projects/kueueviz)
